# Telegrive architecture reference

- Project: https://github.com/daveragos/telegrive
- Reviewed revision: `6489e79f0350ac8d3440f9c00871f7a85159e404`
- Reference project license: GNU GPL version 3.

The project was read to understand transfer scheduling, server-side chat copies, duplicate choices, capture and Google Takeout flows. TeleDrive's changes are independently implemented in its existing Kotlin/Compose/Room/WorkManager/Media3 architecture. No Dart/Flutter source, credentials, logos, binaries or other reference resources were copied into the application. TeleDrive retains its existing manifest/index format and UI design. See [implementation and verification notes](../../docs/TRANSFER-AND-PLAYBACK.md).
